style: Handcrafted wool-felt stop-motion storybook miniature. The whole environment is a tactile sewn and needle-felt set: matte wool surfaces, visible fibers, fine stitches, gentle handmade irregularities, soft directional light, clear shapes and a warm child-friendly palette. Fill the frame edge to edge; no studio tabletop or backdrop. No photorealism, realistic fur, glossy plastic, text, or characters in location plates.
location_workflow: Owner-approved seed plates are composition masters. Lighting variants are derived directly from the registered master only, changing illumination/time while preserving camera, crop, geometry and landmarks. Variants remain in .review until owner review.

stream_afternoon.camera: Fixed 16:9 wide camera at low storybook eye level; broad foreground grass lane.
stream_afternoon.description: Felt forest stream bank in warm afternoon. The shallow stream crosses the middle/right; an open grass lane fills the foreground. A flat feeding stone sits beside the lane, a hollow log rests at the right bank, berry bush at far left, framing trunks and distant hills.
landmarks: flat feeding stone beside foreground lane
stream_afternoon.light: Warm afternoon sun from upper left.
stream_afternoon.ambient: Low-amplitude stream ripple and leaf/grass-tip movement; landforms and landmarks remain fixed.
stream_afternoon.walkable_surface: Continuous broad foreground grass lane and bank; flat feeding stone only when the pose explicitly places a character on it.

depth_planes.midground: feeding stone and near bank, medium scale
depth_planes.background: stream bend and hills, smallest scale

stream_afternoon.occlusion_notes: Near-bank plants or rocks may overlap the lowest paws only when the character is behind them; stream and far-bank landmarks remain behind foreground characters.
stream_afternoon.special_contact_rules: Water is never support. The flat stone is usable only as a deliberately staged stable surface; no standing on vegetation.

fork_sunset.camera: Fixed 16:9 wide camera at low storybook eye level; fork readable from foreground to distance.
fork_sunset.description: Felt forest path divides around a mossy boulder. The safe branch curves left toward a sunlit meadow; the shortcut branch turns right into darker trees. Keep the foreground path broad and walkable.
landmarks: left safe branch and bright meadow opening
right shortcut branch into dark trees
tall trunk just right of center
berry bushes at the outer edges
fork_sunset.light: Low sunset glow from upper left; right branch stays darker.
fork_sunset.ambient: Gentle leaf-tip movement; path, boulder and trees stay fixed.
fork_sunset.walkable_surface: Both dirt path branches are traversable: the left meadow route and right shortcut route.
anchor_landmarks: left safe branch and meadow opening

depth_planes.foreground: path split and boulder, largest scale
depth_planes.background: meadow opening or dark shortcut, smallest scale

fork_sunset.occlusion_notes: The boulder can mask the far edge of either branch; keep a character on the visible path plane, not on top of the boulder.
fork_sunset.special_contact_rules: Walking choice is expressed by which continuous dirt branch supports the paws; foliage and boulder are landmarks, not footing.

shortcut_dusk.camera: Fixed 16:9 side-on wide camera; level running lane across lower frame.
shortcut_dusk.description: Mossy forest lane at dusk with a clear dirt path across the foreground. A mossy boulder marks the left, a raised fallen branch crosses the middle distance above a passable lane, and a stump anchors the right.
landmarks: framing trunks and dusk glow at far left
shortcut_dusk.light: Soft low dusk light, brighter at far left.
shortcut_dusk.ambient: Subtle leaf and grass tips move; rocks, branch, stump and lane remain fixed.
shortcut_dusk.walkable_surface: Continuous level dirt running lane across the lower foreground, beneath the raised branch.

depth_planes.midground: branch and stump line, medium scale
depth_planes.background: dusk opening between trunks, smallest scale

shortcut_dusk.occlusion_notes: The raised branch stays behind/above the running lane; only show overlap if the character passes behind its support point.
shortcut_dusk.special_contact_rules: The branch is overhead and not a walking surface; keep the run path continuous and clear.

tree_dusk.camera: Fixed 16:9 wide camera at low animal eye level; ample level foreground for two characters.
tree_dusk.description: Great tree clearing at dusk. An ancient oak trunk and broad roots dominate center-right. A clear grass clearing and dirt path stretch across the foreground; a mossy mound lies left, with a small stream glimpsed at far left and rocks framing the clearing.
landmarks: great oak trunk and exposed roots at center-right
broad clear foreground path and grass lane
low diagonal foreground root extending from the left mossy mound into the path
tree_dusk.light: Warm sunset rim from far left against cool dusk sky.

tree_dusk.ambient: Subtle canopy and grass movement; stream may ripple softly; trunk, roots, stones and path remain fixed.
tree_dusk.walkable_surface: Broad continuous foreground grass clearing and dirt path. Exposed roots may support paws only when a shot explicitly stages a stable step on a visible root.

depth_planes.midground: root fan and stones, medium scale

tree_dusk.occlusion_notes: Oak roots may occlude a character placed behind the root fan; keep silhouettes clear and preserve stable trunk/root overlap.

tree_sky.camera: Distinct fixed upward-looking 16:9 camera from the great tree base; not the wide-clearing camera.
tree_sky.description: View up the great tree: trunk rises diagonally from lower right into a broad canopy on the upper right, with open dusk sky at left and distant tree silhouettes along the bottom.
tree_sky.light: Dusk with a warm sunset band low left and first stars above.
tree_sky.ambient: Very subtle leaf-tip motion; trunk, canopy boundary and horizon stay fixed.
tree_sky.walkable_surface: None in this upward-looking camera; no character staging is expected.
invalid_support_zones: trunk surface unless a climbing action is explicitly designed

depth_planes.foreground: near trunk edge, if ever staged

tree_sky.occlusion_notes: Leaves and branches overlap the sky; any later climbing character must be physically attached to trunk/branch with clear contact.
tree_sky.special_contact_rules: Treat as a sky establishing view. No standing or resting on leaves.

trap_morning.camera: Fixed 16:9 wide camera at low animal eye level looking along a level path.
trap_morning.description: Empty morning forest path with a wide, unobstructed lane and a substantial overhead branch suitable for a separately designed net prop. No trap hardware or net is part of this location seed.
trap_morning.light: Soft morning sun from upper left.
trap_morning.ambient: Subtle leaf movement; path, roots, branch, stump and boulder remain fixed.
trap_morning.walkable_surface: Wide continuous dirt path receding through the center; use visible level path for standing, running, and rescue staging.

depth_planes.midground: trap/rescue zone beneath branch, medium scale

trap_morning.occlusion_notes: Framing trunks and border ferns can overlap characters only when placed behind them; keep the central path and any later trap/net readable.
trap_morning.special_contact_rules: Branch is a prop-support anchor for a separately designed net, not a character support. Do not stage paws on ferns or rocks.

run_morning.camera: Fixed 16:9 side-on wide camera on a readable running path.
run_morning.description: Morning forest run lane curving diagonally from lower left toward a bright opening. Roots, bushes and a low arching branch frame the route while leaving a continuous, passable path for a small mouse.
landmarks: exposed roots at the path edge
low arched branch above the route
run_morning.light: Soft morning light from the distant opening.
run_morning.ambient: Small leaf-tip movements; route, roots and trunks remain fixed.
run_morning.walkable_surface: One continuous dirt route curving from lower-left foreground toward the bright distant opening.
invalid_support_zones: decorative roots away from the path
run_morning.occlusion_notes: Roots and branch can overlap the route edge but must not visually sever the continuous path; maintain logical left-to-right depth progression.
run_morning.special_contact_rules: A running mouse remains on the path; crossing a root is allowed only where the route visibly meets a low stable root.

home_night.camera: Fixed 16:9 low wide camera facing the burrow approach.

home_night.special_contact_rules: Burrow opening is an entrance, not a surface. Use the stone as footing only when it is visibly flush and intentionally staged.

milo.name: Milo
milo.identity: A small handmade needle-felt mouse matching the owner-approved r03 master: warm neutral-grey finely matted wool with soft handmade irregularities, a rounded forehead and softly continuous cheeks, cream muzzle with a small charcoal nose and closed gentle mouth crease, large moss-green irises with dark pupils and modest visible eye white, fine whiskers, two large rounded ears with dark grey felt interiors, a compact torso with a modest elongated cream chest/belly inset, short sturdy limbs and a muted burnt-orange felt tail. Preserve the master's head/body proportions, soft muzzle shape and wool texture. Keep both ears visible where the registered crop permits. No mane, crest, top-hair tuft, protruding pot belly or elongated/slim body. Milo never shows visible teeth, including smiles, speech or gnawing; use soft felt lips against the knot. Scene illumination may tint the lit side while intrinsic wool colours remain consistent.

owner_mouth_rule.direction: Do not put teeth on Milo.
owner_mouth_rule.scope: Current corrections and all future Milo artwork; other existing images retained as owner requested.

leo.name: Leo
leo.identity: A large quadrupedal needle-felt lion with a pale honey-cream body and natural tawny/golden-brown mane and tail tuft, apricot inner ears, and amber eyes. Maintain four-paw support and a grounded lion silhouette.

lip_sync_policy: Only character dialogue explicitly spoken by the visible character may drive its mouth. Narrator lines are voice-over; visible characters keep a closed or silent expression during narration.

acorn.description: Warm chestnut-brown felt acorn with golden-tan cap and short dark stem; small relative to Milo.

hunter_net.description: Open diamond mesh in natural flax rope with reinforced perimeter and one closure loop. It falls from branch and rests over Leo while four paws stay grounded; Milo gnaws one causal closure strand.

continuity_policy.rule: Retain knot identities, diamond connections, perimeter, closure loop, ground contacts and layer order. Pose changes allow only local tension/gravity-supported deformation. Expression beats protect net pixels. No reknitting or unexplained net-state change.

cast_scale.measurement_note: Owner requests Milo about one-quarter Leo standing-equivalent height at the same depth and camera. This is a new design target, not a measured approval of existing keyframes; all existing Milo images require visual re-review against it.
cast_scale.definition: Milo: ear tips to planted feet in upright neutral pose. Leo: mane top to supporting front paws in quadrupedal neutral pose. Compare at the same depth and camera; sitting or lying changes pose-box height but not anatomy.
cast_scale.rule: At equal depth and camera, Milo upright ear-to-foot height is one-quarter Leo quadrupedal mane-to-front-paw height. Never change anatomy for readability. Only depth or a documented camera crop may change apparent size, and both characters must use the same camera magnification.

production_boundary_mouth_policy.rule: Every production keyframe endpoint remains closed-mouth. Narration, speaker identity and emotion are metadata; storyboard mouth poses never override this boundary contract.
